supports: the prices our calls got, against the close - not whether they were right
beside: record/nfl/published.json carries the win rate. CLV sits beside it and does not replace it: CLV is price, the record is outcome.

entry.rule: the lean-side American price each benchmark book showed at the lean's line in the read the ledger row names

close.store: market_log.db quotes, venue oddsapi:<book>, source 'live', mode=ro
close.rule: each benchmark book's quote at the lean's line at its latest Odds API capture strictly before kickoff; asserted capture_ts < kickoff_ts

entry_rule: a live Odds API capture (source 'live') no more than 6h before the read; an older book-quote is refused, never re-priced

definitions.touch: vig-inclusive implied probability of the lean side, close minus entry, same book
definitions.mid: de-vigged (multiplicative) lean-side probability, close minus entry, same book
definitions.held: de-vigged close minus vig-inclusive entry: a held bet's value if the close is fair
definitions.unit: percentage points, signed, positive = better price than the close
definitions.aggregation: mean over books on both ends within a lean, then mean over leans

exclusions.reason: pending: game not yet kicked off
void (the bet is refunded; CLV has no money meaning)
no read-file row for the lean
no Odds API event for the game
quotes no longer in the store (retention pruned the live rows)
entry refused: every entry book stale (> 6 h) or non-live
no close at the lean's line (line moved or player pulled)
no book on both ends (entry and close books disjoint)

headline.verdict: no measurable CLV; an effect smaller than 0.41pp could not have been seen
headline.statement: 119 of 211 published leans have a price at entry and a close on the same book, line and side; touch CLV -0.08pp [-0.34, +0.24] over 11 games: no measurable CLV; an effect smaller than 0.41pp could not have been seen.
headline.interval: percentile bootstrap resampling games, 10000 draws, seed 20260930
headline.power: MDE at 80% power = 2.8 x bootstrap SE

strata_note: 40 stratum intervals; none is a finding on its own - an interval on fewer than 5 games is not read, and at this count several would exclude zero by chance
gaming: Entering earlier gives prices more time to move either way: more CLV and more risk. See strata.lead.
Entering on a stale quote gives CLV no order could have taken. Refused above the entry age limit; see sensitivity_stale_admitted and strata.entry_age.
A mid-based CLV counts the vig as value. The touch leads; mid is beneath it.
Dropping calls with no close flatters the mean. Every exclusion is counted above.
